info.title: Synapse Layer API
info.description: MCP-Native Trust Infrastructure for AI Agents. Persistent, encrypted memory with AES-256-GCM encryption, cross-agent handover, Trust Quotient scoring, and built-in governance. The Trust Layer for the Agentic Internet.

get.summary: MCP server card for agent discovery.
get.description: Returns the MCP server card with tool definitions, auth requirements, and transport configuration. Used by MCP-compatible clients to discover and configure the Synapse Layer server.
Machine-readable trust manifest. Returns security, compliance, and capability metadata.
Returns current plan pricing, features, and future billing capabilities.
Returns MCP server metadata including tools count, transport options, and integration links.

Returns operational health for the Forge runtime: overall status, product version, server (engine) version, database connectivity and latency, tenant-isolation and privacy-model flags, and embedding/scoring subsystem status. Fields reflect exactly what the runtime emits and may expand over time.

200.description: Health status JSON (e.g. status, version, serverVersion, db, tenantIsolation, privacyModel).

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint. Accepts JSON-RPC 2.0 requests (jsonrpc, method, params, id). Set Accept to include both application/json and text/event-stream; the response is returned as a JSON object or as an SSE stream (data: lines) depending on the method. Example: method "tools/list" returns the available MCP tools. Requires a connect token for authenticated operations.

get.description: Returns lightweight MCP metadata for discovery — server name, product version, protocol, transport, and the endpoint map. This GET does NOT return the tools array (use POST with method "tools/list" for tools). Runtime shape: { name: "synapse-layer", version: "2.4.6", protocol: "mcp", transport: "streamable-http", endpoints: { post: "/mcp" } }.

200.description: MCP metadata JSON (name, version, protocol, transport, endpoints). No tools array is returned by GET.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for a connect token.
post.description: Issues a connect token (sk_connect_*) used for authenticated API/MCP access. The request exchanges an authorization code obtained from the Forge connect flow. Returns 400 (invalid_request) when the authorization code is missing. Note: the handler is served by the Forge runtime (not this repository); the schema below is documented from verified runtime behavior only — no fields are invented.

code.description: Authorization code from the Forge connect flow

get.description: Authenticated health check used to verify a connect token before heavy work. On success (200) returns the caller identity, plan, and memory count for the authenticated tenant. Requires a valid connect token in the x-connect-token header; without one the runtime returns 401 ("Missing or invalid token format."). Only GET is allowed (POST returns 405).

200.description: Authenticated health JSON (identity, plan, memory count).

post.description: Stores a memory in the Forge Vault (AES-256-GCM at rest) via REST — the REST equivalent of the save_to_synapse MCP tool / Synapse.store(). Requires a valid connect token sent in the x-connect-token header (Authorization: Bearer is also accepted by the runtime); without one the runtime returns 401 ("Missing x-connect-token header or Authorization: Bearer token.", code MISSING_TOKEN). Only POST is allowed (GET returns 405).

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata object attached to the memory.

post.summary: Deprecated — legacy V1 handover (permanently disabled, returns 410).
post.description: Retired endpoint. Neural handover is now an MCP tool (neural_handover) and was aligned in the spec in commit c177834. Documented here for runtime transparency ("autopsy"): the endpoint exists and permanently returns 410 Gone. Use Secure Agent Handover V2 via the Forge UI or the neural_handover MCP tool.

410.description: LEGACY_DISABLED — V1 handover is permanently disabled. Use neural_handover (MCP) or Handover V2.

connectToken.name: x-connect-token
connectToken.description: Connect token (sk_connect_xxx) sent in the x-connect-token header. Get your key at https://forge.synapselayer.org/dashboard/connect

x-mcp-tools.x-regeneration: Re-run tools/list on Forge and diff before trusting these schemas.

recall.description: Retrieve memories by semantic query. A reason is required for the audit trail.

reason.description: Why this recall is performed (audit trail)

save_to_synapse.description: Persist an encrypted memory to the Forge Vault (AES-256-GCM at rest). `importance` is accepted for compatibility but is not enforced by the API.

process_text.description: Extract and store salient memories from a block of unstructured text.

search.description: Keyword and semantic search across stored memories.

health_check.description: Return server health and connectivity status.

initialize_context.description: Initialize an agent session context before memory operations.

recall_memory.description: Alias of recall for compatibility. A reason is required for the audit trail.

reason.description: Why this recall is performed (audit trail)

list_memories.description: List stored memories for the authenticated agent/tenant.

memory_feedback.description: Submit feedback on a memory to adjust its Trust Quotient.

neural_handover.description: Consume a handover token to transfer context between agents. A reason is required for the audit trail.

token.description: Handover token (64 hex chars) generated by the source agent

reason.description: Why this handover is consumed (audit trail)

consuming_agent.description: Agent identifier consuming the handover (defaults to token agent)

slo_report.description: Return service-level objective metrics for the authenticated tenant.
